_fixture: Invented data for the system screen family (plugin rack parameters, settings drafts, diagnostics readings, backup archives and recovery checkpoints). Nothing here was measured, saved, backed up, restored or read from a device: battery, thermal, storage budgets, versions, archive sizes, validation results and checkpoint positions are drawn to exercise the screens' states. Acknowledgements printed by the screens ('the store confirmed', 'the host reported') are fixture acknowledgements, not working functionality.

plugins.qualifiedNote: Loads at a qualified time: prepare and state parsing run off the audio callback, never during an armed or running transition.
